dist/

/agent-tools/

/-
/.zcode/
/.vscode/
/%TEMP%*.json
# Per-machine agent backup trees (safety copies before risky edits; never repo content)
/.*-backup*/
/scripts/_*.mjs
/scripts/lib/_*.mjs
/scripts/check-test-temp.mjs
*.bak
*.locked
*.prev
*.repair
*.pre_repair_bak
*.rewrite

*.blend1
**/*_export_tmp.glb
tools/art/blender/batch_*.log
tools/blender/_patch_*.py
**/__pycache__/
/assets/ships/m4_helios_hub/evidence/pre_promote_backups/

# Local worktree recovery / triage (do not commit bulky exports)
_recovery/
/.worktrees/

# Cursor editor hook state — per-machine mutable bookkeeping (session ids, timestamps).
.cursor/

# Fun-loop frame strips are capture evidence (hundreds of MB of PNG); they live in .devshots/fun-loop/ like every other capture.
design/program/roadmap/receipts/fun-loop/strips/

# Agent iteration evidence: capture media are disposable (owner ruling 2026-09-08);
# verdict reports (.md/.json) in evidence/ dirs stay trackable.
assets/**/evidence/*.png
assets/**/evidence/*.jpg
assets/**/evidence/*.jpeg
assets/**/evidence/*.webm
assets/**/evidence/*.mp4
assets/**/evidence/*.gif

# User content ("mods") dropped for the PQ-172 loader — player-installed, never shipped source.
user-content/

# Oversize bench dumps (100MB+; GitHub rejects them): keep the small .md verdicts tracked.
design/program/roadmap/receipts/fun-loop/runs/2026-09-12-fun-bench-summary.json
design/program/roadmap/receipts/fun-loop/runs/2026-09-14-fun-bench-summary.json

# Cinematic bake intermediates — hundreds of PNG frames, re-derivable via tools/cinematic/render-intro.mjs
assets/cinematics/.intro-frames/
tools/cinematic/.boot-video-check.png

.vercel
.env*
